row.notes: (lapTimes, carIdx) Finds the car's player entry (session +0x2e0..+0x2e8, car +0x82), gets profile (0x14243fd10) difficulty byte +0xcea -> slot, and when Sess_LapTimes_IsNewFastestLap(this, car, this+0xbc+slot) is true raises the fastest-lap notification. Called from Sess_LapTimes_OnNewSector.

verify.notes: V3723 Player entry scan +0x2e0 (car +0x82), profile 14243fd10 difficulty byte +0xcea -> slot verified, calls IsNewFastestLap(this,car,this+0xbc+slot) then stores car at +0xbc+slot and sets +0xca=1; it maintains per-difficulty fastest-lap holder, nothing sector/personal-best specific; name misleading (e.g. UpdateFastestLapHolder).

V4171 Finds player entry in session +0x2e0..+0x2e8 (car at +0x82), profile via Sess_ResolveEntityHandle (0x14243fd10), byte +0xcea -> slot table 0x145803c38, calls Sess_LapTimes_IsNewFastestLap with the stored byte at this+0xbc+slot, on true stores car there and sets this+0xca=1; caller Sess_LapTimes_OnNewSector
